subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this grouped-Claw manifest and read-only planning surface as an experimental core CLI contract that later lifecycle PRs may build upon?
rationale: The implementation is intentionally bounded and proof-backed, but choosing a new core manifest, CLI, environment gate, and plan-output contract is a durable product and ownership decision that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Sponsor the read-only core contract
options.body: Approve this bounded planner as the experimental base, retaining the environment gate and separate owner slices for every mutating capability.

options.title: Pause the stack for a narrower boundary
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers decide whether the manifest and planning workflow should instead be reduced, moved behind another extension seam, or redesigned before core adoption.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the read-only core contract
recommendation.body: Approve this bounded planner as the experimental base, retaining the environment gate and separate owner slices for every mutating capability.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied the clearest recorded product-boundary feedback for the host-neutral Claw model and deferred lifecycle ownership decisions.
